fit_card: Score! 🎯 Just snagged this forest green vintage Polo for a literal $18 on thredUp, and the prep-meets-streetwear color is even richer in person. Tell me—are we feeling the effortless retro denim look or the edgy smart-casual vibe first? 🌿✨

Found the ultimate wardrobe gem on Depop: a faded grey vintage band tee for just $19! It has that effortless, lived-in cool factor and is so versatile—I'm already planning to grunge it up with baggy denim and combat boots for weekend gigs, or dress it down with khaki trousers and chunky sneakers for an elevated coffee run. Thrift gods were definitely smiling on this haul! 🎸✨
